sources.title: Wikipedia: George Washington
sources.description: U.S. Founding Father, president from 1789 to 1797

notes.text: George Washington was a Founding Father and the first president of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797.
As commander of the Continental Army, George Washington led Patriot forces to victory in the American Revolutionary War against the British Empire.
George Washington is commonly known as the Father of His Country for his role in bringing about American independence.
George Washington is remembered as a politician connected with United States.
George Washington's recorded life dates place this profile around 1732-1799.
